Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds with exact activity measurements in assay CHEMBL4649962. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and filter by assay_id matching CHEMBL4649962. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
